missing_methods.intent: Verify edit feedback screen is displayed
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the edit feedback screen to be fully loaded and visible. Verify key elements like the feedback text input field, submit button, and screen title are present. Return True if screen is displayed correctly, False otherwise. Should include explicit wait with timeout.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'hpx_feedback_page_title' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Wait for 'edit_feedback' (feedback text input field) to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Swipe to 'send_feedback_submit_btn' using self.driver.swipe
Wait for 'send_feedback_submit_btn' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Wait for 'tell_your_experience_title' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Return True if all elements are present, False otherwise with appropriate exception handling

missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the 'tell your experience' text input field to be visible and interactable. Clear any existing text and input the provided text parameter. Should include explicit wait with timeout and handle any character limits or validation.
implementation_checklist: Swipe to 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.swipe to ensure visibility
Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be visible using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Click on 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.click to focus the field
Clear existing text from 'edit_feedback' by selecting all and deleting (use Keys.CONTROL + 'a' then Keys.DELETE or Keys.BACKSPACE)
Send keys to 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.send_keys with the provided text parameter
Optionally verify text was entered by calling get_entered_text() or self.driver.get_attribute('edit_feedback', 'Value.Value')

missing_methods.intent: Get entered tell your experience text value
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the 'tell your experience' text input field to be present and retrieve its current value/text content. Return the text as a string. Should include explicit wait with timeout.
implementation_checklist: Swipe to 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.swipe to ensure visibility
Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Get attribute 'Value.Value' from 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.get_attribute
Return the retrieved text value as a string

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated to characters
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Get the current value of the 'tell your experience' text field and verify that its length does not exceed the expected maximum character limit. Should retrieve the text value, calculate its length, and assert that length <= expected_max_length. Raise an assertion error with descriptive message if validation fails.
implementation_checklist: Swipe to 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.swipe to ensure visibility
Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Get current text value from 'edit_feedback' using self.driver.get_attribute('edit_feedback', 'Value.Value')
Calculate the length of the retrieved text using len()
Assert that the calculated length is less than or equal to expected_max_length parameter
Optionally wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' using self.driver.wait_for_object with timeout
Optionally get the character count display text from 'edit_feedback_char_count' using self.driver.get_attribute('edit_feedback_char_count', 'Name')
Optionally verify the character count display matches the expected format (e.g., 'X/expected_max_length')
Raise AssertionError with descriptive message including actual length and expected_max_length if validation fails
